@[fun_prop]
theorem sum (h : ∀ σ ∈ s, Meromorphic (G σ)) :
    Meromorphic (∑ n ∈ s, G n) :=
  Finset.sum_induction _ Meromorphic (fun _ _ ↦ add) (fun x ↦ .const 0 x) h

@[fun_prop]
theorem fun_sum (h : ∀ σ ∈ s, Meromorphic (G σ)) :
    Meromorphic (fun x ↦ ∑ n ∈ s, G n x) := by
  simpa [← Finset.sum_apply] using (sum h)
